_readme: Real Google reviews copied from the Trustindex widget on livejunkfree.ca. Do not edit or add reviews by hand.

reviews.name: CG GG
reviews.text: So friendly and amazing work they brought a huge bin into my unit and baggee garage rolled it out amazing service fast and efficient

reviews.name: SSH Canine Academy
reviews.text: These guys were great. Not only did they come on time, they picked everything I sent them in the photos. There were a couple extra pieces of wood and they took them too at no extra charge. Polite, punctual, and kind. What more could you ask for? Will definitely call them again for junk removal

reviews.name: Raymond Chan
reviews.text: It was an excellent service! Very professional and gently handle to remove the large and heavy water tank… highly recommended!

reviews.name: Suzette Legault
reviews.text: Nav and Ash got here before the designated time. That was great. They were extremely polite, and very efficient. A couch I had for 22 years was up and out the door in less than 10 min. I could not believe it! Nothing bumped or bumped off walls or anything. I'd recommend them to anyone. Experts for sure!

reviews.name: Madelyn Volpe
reviews.text: We had a great experience with LiveJunkFree! They removed all the old appliances from my daughter’s condo, and the entire process was smooth and hassle-free. The team was professional, efficient, and handled everything with care. It was such a relief to have everything taken care of without any stress. We really appreciated their service and would happily recommend LiveJunkFree to anyone looking for reliable and professional appliance removal. Thank you for making the process so easy!

reviews.name: Libbie Lightstone
reviews.text: They let me know when they were a half-hour away. They were very professional and lovely to work with.

reviews.name: Rifka N
reviews.text: Nice, professional team that was fast and efficient!

reviews.name: Joan Savage
reviews.text: The two men were excellent at removing our freezer from the basement... punctual and very efficient. Thank you very much.

reviews.name: Heather Gilroy
reviews.text: Great service. Friendly, quick, polite and called when they were 30 minutes away to let me know their ETA.

reviews.name: C L
reviews.text: Nav and his partner came for a piano removal, they communicated well and were professional. Thanks for your help and coming back to put the door back, much appreciated! Would recommend to friends and family.
